HOperatorTrace.nuclear_complement_trace.{u_1, u_2} {κ : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (S : Submodule ℂ H) [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (u v : κ → H) (hc : Summable fun n => ‖u n‖ * ‖v n‖) (hT : ∀ (x : H), HasSum (fun n => ⟪u n, x⟫_ℂ • v n) (T x)) :
  Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((1 - S.starProjection).comp T) = ∑' (n : κ), ⟪u n, v n - S.starProjection (v n)⟫_ℂ
'HOperatorTrace.nuclear_complement_trace' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
HOperatorTrace.source_compression_extension.{u_2} {H : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H] (S : Submodule ℂ H) [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (hz : ((1 - S.starProjection).comp A).comp S.starProjection = 0) :
  Sᗮ.subtypeL.comp ((Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection.comp (A.comp Sᗮ.subtypeL)).comp Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection) =
    (1 - S.starProjection).comp A

  (hz : ((1 - S.starProjection).comp A).comp S.starProjection = 0) (u v : κ → ↥Sᗮ)
  (hc : Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖)
  (hB : ∀ (y : ↥Sᗮ), HasSum (fun i => ⟪u i, y⟫_ℂ • v i) ((Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection.comp (A.comp Sᗮ.subtypeL)) y)) :
